title: A Dead CareLink Login, Fixed With One Command | vitalii.no
description:
The sugar hub depends on a CareLink session token that has to be refreshed on a schedule. If that refresh ever failed or got interrupted partway through, the service could end up with a corrupted token and no feed at all — and the only way to notice was checking manually, then fixing it by hand on the server.

The token refresh in bridge/sugar_hub.py is now atomic: it writes to a temp file and renames it into place, so a failed or interrupted refresh can never leave a half-written, corrupted token behind. If a refresh fails outright, the service sends a Telegram alert immediately instead of staying silently broken. And when CareLink needs a fresh login, bridge/relogin.sh re-authenticates the whole service in one command instead of walking through the login flow by hand.

A broken session now announces itself over Telegram the moment it happens and gets fixed with one script instead of manual server debugging, and a failed token refresh can no longer corrupt the stored session.
